title: TeslaSync design tokens (neutral)
description: Platform-agnostic design-token contract per ADR-005. Defines the SHAPE of the neutral token layer that P1 (S9) fills with VALUES extracted from web/src, and that the per-platform generators map to Fluent / Material 3 / HIG. No literal values live here.

color.description: Semantic color roles (not raw hex scattered), keyed by appearance variant. P1/S9 fills light / dark / high-contrast. Each variant carries the same semantic role set; status roles cover success/warning/danger/info.

chart.description: Brand data-viz palette. Ordered categorical palette (matches web CHART_COLORS) plus per-series semantic colors used across charts.

categorical.description: Ordered categorical palette array, index-stable across platforms (matches web CHART_COLORS).

series.description: Per-series semantic color roles (e.g. battery, energy, speed, regen, temperature).

typography.description: Type ramp + weights. Role names map to Fluent type ramp, M3 Typography, and HIG text styles.

spacing.description: Spacing scale on a 4pt base. Named steps map to each platform's layout units (DIP / dp / pt).

scale.description: Named spacing steps derived from the 4pt base.

elevation.description: Elevation/material levels including glass/material mapping (Mica/Acrylic, M3 tonal surfaces, SwiftUI materials).

material.description: Glass/material mapping per level: Fluent Mica/Acrylic, M3 tonal elevation, HIG .regularMaterial/.thinMaterial.

motion.description: Animation durations + easing curves, mapped to Fluent motion, M3 motion, and SwiftUI animations.

colorVariant.description: One appearance variant (light / dark / high-contrast) of the semantic color roles.

surfaceGlass.description: Translucent glass/material surface (maps to Mica/Acrylic, M3 tonal surface, .regularMaterial).
